COUPLE RETREAT

Japan Couple Odyssey

Tokyo nights, a Hakone onsen, then Kyoto’s quieter lanes.

8 Days / 7 NightsTokyo, 3N · Hakone, 1N · Kyoto, 3NQuoted for your hotels and rail

Overview

A couple’s first Japan without a tour-bus timetable. Three nights in Tokyo for neighbourhoods and evenings, one night in Hakone for onsen and a Fuji view if the weather allows, then Kyoto for temples and Gion after dark.

Highlights

  • Three nights in Tokyo — one neighbourhood as your base.
  • A Hakone night with onsen access as the ryokan offers it.
  • Three nights in Kyoto for Fushimi Inari or Arashiyama at a sane hour.
  • Shinkansen or reserved rail as quoted.

Why this trip

  • Cities and one mountain pause, without covering the whole country.
  • Vegetarian dining can be researched restaurant by restaurant.
  • Visa guidance for Indian passports, timed to your tickets.

Itinerary

Suggested order: Tokyo, Hakone, Kyoto. Osaka departure can replace a return to Tokyo.

  1. 01

    Day 1 · Tokyo

    Arrive in Tokyo

    Transfer in and keep the first evening light.

    Arrival
    Narita or Haneda transfer as quoted.
    Evening
    Dinner near the hotel.

    Overnight Tokyo · night 1 of 3

  2. 02

    Day 2 · Tokyo

    A neighbourhood day

    One district, walked properly.

    Day
    Yanaka, Daikanyama or Asakusa — not all three.
    Evening
    Shibuya or a quieter izakaya street.

    Overnight Tokyo · night 2 of 3

  3. 03

    Day 3 · Tokyo

    A second city day

    Museums, teamLab, or shopping — as you prefer.

    Day
    At leisure, or an activity added to the quote.
    Evening
    A last Tokyo dinner.

    Overnight Tokyo · night 3 of 3

  4. 04

    Day 4 · Hakone

    Into the mountains

    Rail to Hakone and an onsen evening.

    Day
    Transfer and check-in; lake or ropeway if time allows.
    Evening
    Onsen and ryokan dinner if that is your plan.

    Overnight Hakone · night 1 of 1

  5. 05

    Day 5 · Kyoto

    West to Kyoto

    Morning in Hakone, then the shinkansen.

    Day
    Travel to Kyoto and hotel transfer.
    Evening
    A first walk in Gion or Pontocho.

    Overnight Kyoto · night 1 of 3

  6. 06

    Day 6 · Kyoto

    Temples at a human hour

    Fushimi Inari early, or Arashiyama if you prefer bamboo to gates.

    Morning
    One major site, started early.
    Afternoon
    A quieter lane or tea.
    Evening
    Kaiseki or a simpler dinner as you wish.

    Overnight Kyoto · night 2 of 3

  7. 07

    Day 7 · Kyoto

    A last Kyoto day

    Nijo, a craft street, or rest.

    Day
    At leisure.
    Evening
    A last dinner together.

    Overnight Kyoto · night 3 of 3

  8. 08

    Day 8 · Kyoto

    Departure

    Kansai or a return to Tokyo, as ticketed.

    Departure
    Airport transfer as quoted.
